turns.question: How many customers did we have in September 2026?
turns.answer: "Customers" is ambiguous, so here are the three meanings for 1-30 September 2026: Signups (customers who signed up) were 9, Active customers (distinct customers with a non-cancelled order) were 10, and Customers to date (everyone signed up by 30 September) is reported as 9 by the tool. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
